@http.description: Mark an interface as using XIDL HTTP mapping

@get.description: Mark a method as a GET request

@post.description: Mark a method as a POST request

@put.description: Mark a method as a PUT request

@patch.description: Mark a method as a PATCH request

@delete.description: Mark a method as a DELETE request

@head.description: Mark a method as a HEAD request

@options.description: Mark a method as an OPTIONS request

@query.description: Mark a parameter as coming from the query string

@header.description: Mark a parameter as an HTTP header

@cookie.description: Mark a parameter as an HTTP cookie

@deprecated.description: Mark an interface or method as deprecated
